selection: First eligible unused CC-BY COCO val2017 sources by image ID, categories 75/77/44/47; every target bbox covers 0.4%-60% of image, one target or 2-4 targets. Two single/two multiple targets in each split, then one annotated-absent category per image. Exclude all IDs in existing public evaluation manifests. Selected before image inference; no runtime rules depend on these IDs.
